Dialogue.Line: It doesn't look like it's been touched in a while.
The shelves are lined with weathered tomes. Most have not been touched in years.
Dust clings to every volume. Whatever knowledge these books hold has long been forgotten.
Only fragments of the bookshelf remain, crushed beneath the rubble.
A stone statue of Lunaria watches silently over the courtyard.
Time has worn away many of its details, but its gentle expression remains.
A large telescope is positioned beneath the observatory dome.
Its lenses are clouded with dust, as though no one has looked to the stars in ages.
Splintered crates lie buried beneath fallen stone from the collapsed east wing.
The fountain has long since frozen over. Not even the faintest trickle of water remains.
The clock tower stands untouched beneath layers of snow.
None seems to have echoed through this place for a very long time.
